_comment: A snapshot of six `otelq logs --since 7d` instant queries, whose LogQL is under `queries`, taken on the date below against the Loki otelq resolved (10.43.99.158:3100, the cluster Loki; every api_request in the window came from linux/amd64). It exists because skills/orchestrating-subagents/SKILL.md quotes subagent-cost figures and nothing tied them to a query (#578). The literals it carried until this snapshot ($988 of subagent cost, $454 of agent_summary, $1.19 per subagent across 381, measured 2026-08-23) had no report behind them, and their window is older than Loki's 31-day retention, so they cannot be re-derived. tests/subagent-cost.test.js computes every figure the paragraph quotes from the raw rows here and asserts each one appears in it, so a hand-edited number goes red. Definitions the test applies: subagent cost is the sum of cost_usd over every query_source starting `agent:` (builtin and custom agent types); `sdk` is a headless session's main thread and is excluded; the denominator is the count of subagent_completed events, all of which carry is_async=true, so it counts completed background subagents, not every subagent. cost_usd is Claude Code's list-price estimate, not a bill. Values are kept as the strings Loki returned. To refresh: re-run the six queries, replace this file, and rewrite the paragraph from it in the same commit. The window is rolling, so a rerun never reproduces a snapshot exactly; the test compares the prose against THIS file, never against a fresh query.
